items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: Joe Russo, the conductor, he would give you a dirty look.

ctx.x: Yeah. But we played seven days a week. And if you asked for a day off, Joe Russo, the conductor, he would give you a dirty look.
Really. But you were still a teenager.
